Elena Gomez: heads-up: customer 'Mosaic Clinic' private deployment reported intermittent secret decrypt failures after a scheduled maintenance window. Apps returned 403 for ~10 minutes.
Priyash Shah: when did maintenance run? any infra changes besides KMS rotation?
Elena Gomez: maintenance start 2026-02-18T11:00 UTC, included key rotation + small netpol tweak pushed for keystore-proxy pods.
sec-bot: Alert: tenant=mosaic decrypt_403_rate spike at 2026-02-18T11:03:09Z. Audit ref: maint-20260218-11.
Nina Park: paste keystore-proxy logs (sanitized) please.
Elena Gomez: ```
2026-02-18T11:03:08Z keystore-proxy ERROR tenant=mosaic msg="decrypt denied" code=403 key=kms://mosaic/key-v2 principal=svc-mosaic-01
2026-02-18T11:03:08Z netpol-controller INFO evaluated policy allow-egress-hsm for pod=ks-proxy-7f8
2026-02-18T11:03:09Z hsm-connector WARN principal-check failed: principal not authorized for key-version
```
Priyash Shah: sequencing looks like alias swap + netpol tweak. Could the netpol have been too restrictive and caused a flaky path to the HSM that resulted in retries while principal propagation lagged?
sec-bot: Netflow check: no connection resets; packets reached HSM endpoint. Principal propagation log shows a delayed patch to key-policy due to a race in infra-agent applying CRD updates under load.
Nina Park: ok so primary cause is principal not in policy. How did propagation fail?
Priyash Shah: infra-agent v2.1.1 applies alias then CRD update that grants principals. Under heavy API load the CRD patch to policy retried and eventually applied 30s later. Meanwhile requests hit new key and failed.
Elena Gomez: mitigation applied: Oncall Ops manually added svc-mosaic-01 to policy and verified decrypts.
Oncall Ops: ran: `kmsctl patch-policy --key key-v2 --add-principal svc-mosaic-01 --actions decrypt` exit 0. App responses returned 200 within two attempts.
Priyash Shah: action items: 1) add pre-rotate check to ensure principal list present before alias flip; 2) make propagation transactional (alias swap only after principals confirmed); 3) add a transient-backoff in keystore-proxy so client retries with exponential backoff on 403 for first 60s with a special header for idempotency; 4) instrument infra-agent to surface propagation latency metric.
Nina Park: security extras: ensure principal scoping is tenant-limited and add a policy that new keys default to inherit principals from previous key version unless explicitly altered. Also require mTLS short-lived certs for keystore-proxy.
sec-bot: Audit artifacts attached: rotation job log, policy-change events, netflow snapshot. Reminder: update private deploy preflight checkbox to include principal-propagation smoke test.
Elena Gomez: customer comms draft: "We identified a timing issue during key rotation that briefly removed principal access for your keystore proxy. We applied a manual fix and are changing rotation to validate principal parity before swapping aliases. No secrets were exposed." Approve?
Priyash Shah: add ETA: hotfix within 48 hours, full rollout in 2 weeks. Include link to postmortem when ready.
Nina Park: I'll follow up on RBAC hardening ticket to ensure principals can't be widened during emergency grants.
Elena Gomez: thanks all, closing thread once postmortem doc is linked in #eng-security.
